units.source_text: 《史记》鲁周公世家中周公诫子伯禽曰：“我文王之子，武王之弟，成王之叔父。

en.t: In the Hereditary House of the Duke of Zhou of Lu in Records of the Grand Historian, the Duke of Zhou admonished his son Boqin, saying: "I am the son of King Wen, the younger brother of King Wu, and the uncle of King Cheng.
In all the world, my rank is certainly not low."

units.source_text: 源氏以桐壶上皇比文王，以朱雀帝比武王，自比周公旦。

en.t: Genji compared the retired Emperor Kiritsubo to King Wen, Emperor Suzaku to King Wu, and himself to the Duke of Zhou, Dan.

units.source_text: 倘以皇太子比成王，则源氏是叔父，触及他的隐事，所以不诵下去。

en.t: If he were to compare the Crown Prince to King Cheng, then Genji would be the uncle, touching on his own hidden affair, and so he did not recite any further.
